subject: Trial kickoff & infra options — success criteria and next steps
messages:
From: Alexandre Morel <alexandre.morel@medpilot.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medpilot.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial kickoff request + quick clarification on success criteria

Thanks for the demo today — high level was helpful. We want to move to a short trial (3 weeks) to validate two things:

1) Latency and throughput when we run our triage jobs against a 10k record dataset (typical daily backlog).
2) Answer quality on intent classification and entity extraction compared to our current rule-based pipeline (we'll provide a 500-query eval set).

Two questions before we lock dates:
- For a quick trial can you host us on Hosted API with a pre-warmed sandbox, or do you recommend Dedicated sandbox for more representative throughput numbers?
- We will be sending PHI-ish test data (de-identified but still sensitive). What are the recommended controls for that — VPC trial or is Hosted with encryption-at-rest enough for an initial run?

We want a short mutual action plan and owners so we can get approval from our procurement and security teams. Priya (cc) will coordinate compliance.

Thanks,
Alexandre Morel
Head of ML, MedPilot
alexandre.morel@medpilot.ai
+1 415 555 0138

[Attachment: medpilot_poc_scope_v1.pdf]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandre Morel <alexandre.morel@medpilot.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff request + quick clarification on success criteria

Alexandre — great to hear, and happy to move quickly. Quick recap and a proposed plan below. I copied Ben for infra/ops and Marissa for security/compliance follow-up (added in next mail).

Post-call recap / what you asked for:
- 3-week trial focused on throughput (10k/day backlog sim) and answer quality (500-query eval set).
- Need clear success metrics + owners for procurement and security approval.
- Want guidance on Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC for sensitive test data.

Proposed trial options (short summary):
- Hosted Quickstart (fastest): Redwood-hosted model endpoint, pre-warmed sandbox. Pros: <2 day setup, low friction. Cons: cannot guarantee isolated GPU pool; acceptable for highly de-identified data.
- Dedicated Sandbox (recommended for representative perf): Reserved capacity in a dedicated GPU pool with tenant isolation. Pros: representative latency/throughput; predictable CPU/GPU. Cons: 3–5 day provisioning lead time, small reserved cost.
- VPC Trial (for compliance): Private control plane + customer network. Pros: supports PHI workflows, customer-managed egress rules, KMS/HSM options. Cons: longer setup (1–2 weeks), requires network coordination with your infra team.

Suggested immediate steps (owner listed):
1) Decision on hosting tier and timeline — Alexandre / Priya — due Tue 6/29.
2) Provide eval dataset and sample traffic pattern CSV — Alexandre — due Wed 6/30.
3) Redwood to share trial matrix (configs, expected costs, SLOs) — Ben — sending attached redwood_trial_matrix.xlsx today.
4) Security questionnaire + required evidence for VPC (if chosen) — Marissa — will follow with SOC2 artifacts and network checklist.
5) Kickoff call to align on runbook and day 0 test — schedule once hosting is selected.

Baseline success metrics (proposal):
- Median token latency under 250ms for 99th percentile for single-request workloads (subject to dataset shape).
- Sustained throughput: ability to process 10k-record backlog in <6 hours using a batch-run config (we can simulate).
- Quality: >=10% lift in F1 on intent classification vs your baseline on the 500-query eval set, or equivalent stakeholder sign-off.

If that sounds good I'll draft a 1-page mutual action plan and we can attach it to procurement. Ben will share the trial matrix now.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

[Attachment referenced: redwood_trial_matrix.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandre Morel <alexandre.morel@medpilot.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff request + quick clarification on success criteria

Alexandre — quick notes from an ops perspective and a couple of clarifying asks.

1) If you want representative throughput numbers, Dedicated Sandbox is the closest match to production. We can pre-configure the pool to approximate your target concurrency and batch sizes.
2) For the PHI question: Hosted is fine for highly de-identified material but if there's any risk of re-identification or if your security team needs dedicated network isolation, we should default to VPC Trial. Marissa will attach the SOC2 & encryption detail.

Clarifying asks (Alexandre/Priya):
- Can you share an anonymized sample row schema and an example request/response payload? That will let us estimate token counts and cost.
- Are you planning mostly synchronous API calls (user-facing) or large batch runs (offline batch triage)? That changes the recommended instance sizing.

I also pushed a quick version of the trial matrix to the Drive link Jordan shared (same file attached here). I'll own provisioning once we have the hosting decision and the dataset.

Ben
Ben Carter
Trial Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
